title: Gravitational Lensing
description: Light follows geodesics too: a mass bends the light passing it, twice as much as Newton would say, and a mass exactly between you and a star turns it into a ring. Unlocks the Lensing Concentrator.

puzzle.goal: A ray passes a mass M at closest distance b and is bent. Write the angle α it turns through, with G and c.
puzzle.name: Einstein deflection
puzzle.ask: Find α in arcseconds for starlight grazing the Sun: M = 1.989e30 kg, b = @{b} m, G = 6.674e-11, c = 2.998e8 m/s.
puzzle.method: Newton gives 2GM/(c²b); curved space adds as much again, which Eddington's 1919 eclipse confirmed.
